Good news at 13: you don't need anything fancy, and nobody can promise "fast". Abs show when you build them with simple core work like planks, hanging knee raises and dead bugs, and also keep up regular training, enough sleep, and eating enough real food. Whether they show also depends a lot on genetics and on how your body is growing, so don't chase a deadline.

At your age, skip any crash diets or "fat burning" products. Eating enough to grow and training consistently is what works. If you want a plan, I can build you a simple beginner routine that includes core work, and a coach, PE teacher or doctor can help make sure it suits your growing body.
